program_name: Saskatchewan First Nations and Metis Community Partnership Projects
funder: Government of Saskatchewan — First Nations Metis and Northern Affairs
amount_notes: Total pool is $400,000 shared across all recipients. Individual grant amounts not stated — contact funder.
organization_types_eligible: Organizations and community groups serving First Nations communities in Saskatchewan
Organizations and community groups serving Metis communities in Saskatchewan
Partnership organizations working with First Nations or Metis communities
eligibility_criteria: Must propose innovative partnerships with First Nations or Metis communities in Saskatchewan
Project must align with priority areas: safe communities, strong families, student achievement, or economic growth
Must demonstrate benefit to Indigenous people and communities in Saskatchewan
Application submitted to First Nations Metis and Northern Relations unit
